description: Stealing system configuration - steal from NPCs or players with social consequences

dusty_trails.steal_command_flavor: You eye the place, looking for an opportunity...

general-store.caught_message: Katie spots your hand in the till! "What in tarnation do you think you're doing?!"
general-store.success_message: You pocket some goods while Katie's back is turned. Smooth as butter.

long-branch-saloon.caught_message: Miss Kitty catches your wrist in an iron grip. "Honey, that was a mistake."
long-branch-saloon.success_message: The saloon's busy enough that nobody notices your light fingers.

sheriffs-office.caught_message: The Sheriff's hand drops to his holster. "Now that was mighty stupid, partner."
sheriffs-office.success_message: You slip something out of the evidence locker. The Sheriff never even looked up.

player_theft.caught_message: They catch you red-handed! "What do you think you're doing, you varmint?!"
player_theft.success_message: You slip some coins from their pocket. They're none the wiser.

gossip_network.description: Word travels fast in a small frontier town

heros_journey.steal_command_flavor: You look around for valuables, keeping to the shadows...

the-prancing-pony.caught_message: Bran's meaty hand clamps down on your shoulder. "Thought you could rob MY inn?"
the-prancing-pony.success_message: The common room is crowded. No one notices you helping yourself.

village-square.caught_message: Cassian's eyes go wide. "Thief! THIEF in the market!"
village-square.success_message: Cassian's distracted by another customer. Perfect timing.

wizards-tower.caught_message: Elowen's eyes flash with arcane light. "You DARE steal from a wizard?!"
wizards-tower.success_message: The wizard is deep in research. You carefully extract something valuable.

enchanted-forest.caught_message: Victor emerges from the shadows. "I saw everything, friend. Everything."
enchanted-forest.success_message: Victor's camp is unguarded. You help yourself to some supplies.

player_theft.caught_message: They spin around and catch you! "Thief! You dare?!"
player_theft.success_message: Your fingers find their coin purse. They never felt a thing.

gossip_network.description: The village is tight-knit. Word spreads quickly.

black_serenity.steal_command_flavor: You scan the area for security gaps and valuable targets...

mos-eisley-cantina.caught_message: *Merchant squeals in alarm* "EEE-CHOO! Utinni utinni!" *points accusingly*
mos-eisley-cantina.success_message: The little merchant is distracted haggling. You help yourself to the cart.

the-forge.caught_message: Garron's welding torch swings toward you. "Stealing from MY forge?!"
the-forge.success_message: Sparks fly everywhere. Perfect cover for lifting some components.

terraforming-station.caught_message: Mara gasps, hand over her heart. "How COULD you?! These are living things!"
terraforming-station.success_message: Mara's absorbed in her plants. She doesn't notice you pocketing samples.

neural-jack-lounge.caught_message: Cipher's eyes snap open. "Bad move, sweetheart. Very bad move."
neural-jack-lounge.success_message: Cipher's lost in the dreamscape. You grab what you can and slip away.

neon-underground.caught_message: Aiko's knife appears at your throat. "Wrong target, choom. Very wrong."
neon-underground.success_message: Aiko's busy with a deal. You lift something from her stash.

ships-bridge.caught_message: Lyra's hand slams down on the console. "Security to the bridge. NOW."
ships-bridge.success_message: Lyra's focused on navigation. You pocket some valuable tech.

player_theft.caught_message: They whirl around! "Hey! What do you think you're doing?!"
player_theft.success_message: Credits transferred. They won't notice until they check their balance.

gossip_network.description: On a space station, everyone talks. Especially about thieves.

caught_by_victim.description: The NPC you tried to steal from loses significant trust in you

caught_witnesses.description: Word spreads to connected NPCs who also lose trust

caught_gossip_network.description: The whole community hears about it eventually

caught.description: When caught stealing from a player, you lose some of your own money

messages.cooldown: You need to lay low for a while. Wait {seconds} seconds.
messages.no_target: There's nothing worth stealing here. Try a shop or another player.
messages.target_broke: {target} doesn't have anything worth stealing right now.
messages.self_steal: You can't steal from yourself. That's not how this works.
messages.help:
**Stealing Commands:**
`!steal` - See what you can steal in this location
`!steal items` - Steal items from the local NPC
`!steal gold/dollars/credits` - Steal currency
`!steal @player` - Attempt to pickpocket another player
